name: mediawiki/basic-image-editor
description: In-browser crop, rotate, flip, straighten, brightness and contrast for uploaded JPG and PNG files

phpunit: bash -c 'cd ${MW_INSTALL_PATH:-../..} && { [ -f tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php ] && { php tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; [ -f phpunit.xml ] || printf "%s" "<phpunit><!-- generatePHPUnitConfig --></phpunit>" > phpunit.xml; } || true; } && MEDIAWIKI_HAS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c extensions/BasicImageEditor/phpunit.xml.dist --bootstrap tests/phpunit/bootstrap.php --testdox'
phpunit-coverage: bash -c 'cd ${MW_INSTALL_PATH:-../..} && { [ -f tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php ] && { php tests/phpunit/generatePHPUnitConfig.php >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; [ -f phpunit.xml ] || printf "%s" "<phpunit><!-- generatePHPUnitConfig --></phpunit>" > phpunit.xml; } || true; } && MEDIAWIKI_HAS_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c extensions/BasicImageEditor/phpunit.xml.dist --bootstrap tests/phpunit/bootstrap.php --testdox --coverage-text --coverage-html extensions/BasicImageEditor/coverage/php --coverage-clover extensions/BasicImageEditor/coverage/php/coverage.xml'
